Measured value-stack Goto inside fraction numerator/denominator,radical,Abs,log-base argument,and a fraction nested inside a radical; raw textual sin,ln and sinh source offsets measured separately.

Native horizontal panning exposes the next glyph inside the focused slot. Scroll arrows clear only a14-pixel band around the expression baseline; partially off-screen glyphs are omitted whole,while radical bars remain visible through the screen edges.

Log-base keeps the first numeric argument pending while evaluating the second:10 values in its argument succeed(result5.781359714),11 values raise Stack ERROR. These are observed PLUS expectations,not manual-only mathematical examples.

Unclosed denominator parentheses(three frames),pre-error denominator exit(one frame),and unary-operator capacity inside a radical(five frames)remain deferred. Matching isolated error frames from the unary group are not accepted as separate completed cases.

Source mapping is guarded by equality of original serialization and evaluated text. Calculus reduction,random/DMS rewrites,registered f/g,scientific-number templates,cube/nth roots and other unmeasured templates retain existing error mapping.

Demo.9:all five unary-sign radical continuation frames remeasured exactly and reactivated without changing native pixels,statuses or original keys. Remaining referenceOnly entries concern denominator syntax/exit.
